findings.issue_text: pkg/expr/reader.go:193 — enableSqlExpressions always returns false regardless of IsEnabledGlobally, so SQL expressions can never be enabled even when the feature flag is on, and the flag check is inverted/dead logic (variable named "enabled" holds the negation and both branches return false)

pkg/expr/sql/db.go:12 — DB.TablesList stub always returns "not implemented" error, so any code path that reaches it (e.g. pkg/expr/sql/parser.go TablesList) will always fail even if the reader.go gate were fixed

pkg/expr/sql/db.go:16 — DB.QueryFramesInto stub always returns "not implemented" error, meaning SQLCommand.Execute in pkg/expr/sql_command.go always fails for any SQL expression query, making the feature entirely non-functional post-refactor
pkg/expr/sql/db.go:236 — DB.TablesList unconditionally returns errors.New("not implemented"), so any code path that previously listed SQL tables now always fails with no real query attempted

pkg/expr/sql/db.go:244 — DB.QueryFramesInto unconditionally returns errors.New("not implemented"), so SQLCommand.Execute always fails for every SQL expression query, breaking all existing alerts/dashboards that use SQL expressions in production

pkg/expr/sql/parser.go:266 — TablesList (package-level, sql_expr) now calls the always-failing DB.RunCommands stub, so any caller relying on table-list introspection for SQL expressions (e.g. autocompletion, validation) will silently fail with "not implemented"

pkg/expr/reader.go:203 — Error message "sqlExpressions is not implemented" is misleading: this was a previously working, real feature (backed by go-duck) being pulled out, not a never-shipped feature, so users/on-call engineers seeing this message will misdiagnose a regression as a missing feature and may not roll back or escalate promptly

pkg/expr/sql_command.go:293 — No added logging/metrics/telemetry beyond a Debug/Error log line accompanies this wholesale disablement of SQL expressions; there's no distinguishing signal (e.g. a specific error code, metric counter, or deprecation notice) to distinguish "library removed intentionally" from "backend outage," making detection and alerting on the regression harder for SREs monitoring error rates

pkg/expr/sql/db.go:233 — The new stub DB type is indistinguishable in its exported API from a working implementation (same method signatures), so any downstream consumer or test that mocks success will not catch that SQL execution is now permanently broken until it hits production; there is no compile-time or startup-time signal that this feature is non-functional

go.mod:1 — Removing the go-duck dependency without an accompanying rollback plan or version gate means there is no way to restore SQL expression functionality without a code revert and full redeploy, unlike a feature flag that could be flipped for quick rollback

pkg/expr/reader.go:213 — Missing edge-case tests for both flag states (enabled/disabled) of `FlagSqlExpressions`, which would have immediately surfaced that `enableSqlExpressions` cannot return true under any input

adjudication.rationale: The diff does add pkg/expr/sql/db.go with a DB.TablesList method that always returns `errors.New("not implemented")`, but the cited code path `pkg/expr/sql/parser.go` does not call `DB.TablesList` at all. `parser.go` calls `duckDB := NewInMemoryDB()` and then `duckDB.RunCommands(...)`, so the specific claim that `DB.TablesList` makes `parser.go TablesList` always fail is not verifiable from the diff (even though `RunCommands` is also stubbed and would be the immediate failure point).

adjudication.rationale: The diff replaces the prior DuckDB implementation (`github.com/scottlepp/go-duck/duck`) with a new `pkg/expr/sql.DB` stub where `TablesList`, `RunCommands`, and `QueryFramesInto` all unconditionally return `errors.New("not implemented")` (new `pkg/expr/sql/db.go`). `pkg/expr/sql/parser.go`’s `TablesList` now calls `NewInMemoryDB().RunCommands(...)`, which will always fail, so table-listing behavior is effectively broken/regressed. adjudication_records.issue_text: pkg/expr/sql/db.go:244 — DB.QueryFramesInto unconditionally returns errors.New("not implemented"), so SQLCommand.Execute always fails for every SQL expression query, breaking all existing alerts/dashboards that use SQL expressions in production

adjudication.rationale: The diff replaces the previous DuckDB-backed implementation (github.com/scottlepp/go-duck/duck) with a new pkg/expr/sql DB stub. In pkg/expr/sql/db.go, DB.QueryFramesInto always returns errors.New("not implemented"). SQLCommand.Execute was updated to call sql.NewInMemoryDB() and then db.QueryFramesInto(...), so any execution path that reaches SQLCommand.Execute for SQL expressions will fail with this error. (Separately, enableSqlExpressions() in reader.go also always returns false, which further disables SQL expressions entirely.)

adjudication_records.issue_text: pkg/expr/sql/parser.go:266 — TablesList (package-level, sql_expr) now calls the always-failing DB.RunCommands stub, so any caller relying on table-list introspection for SQL expressions (e.g. autocompletion, validation) will silently fail with "not implemented"

adjudication.rationale: In pkg/expr/sql/parser.go, TablesList now does `duckDB := NewInMemoryDB()` (package `sql`), which refers to the newly added pkg/expr/sql/db.go stub. That DB’s `RunCommands` method unconditionally returns `errors.New("not implemented")`, so TablesList’s `duckDB.RunCommands(...)` will always fail at runtime. Previously it used `github.com/scottlepp/go-duck/duck.NewInMemoryDB()` (an actual implementation). While the finding says "silently fail", the diff shows it will fail with an explicit error, not silently—but the core claim that table introspection is now broken is directly supported by the diff.

adjudication_records.issue_text: go.mod:1 — Removing the go-duck dependency without an accompanying rollback plan or version gate means there is no way to restore SQL expression functionality without a code revert and full redeploy, unlike a feature flag that could be flipped for quick rollback

adjudication.rationale: The diff removes the `github.com/scottlepp/go-duck/duck` dependency and replaces DB usage with a new `pkg/expr/sql` `DB` whose methods all return `errors.New("not implemented")` (e.g., `QueryFramesInto`, `RunCommands`). Additionally, `ReadQuery` now gates `QueryTypeSQL` behind `enableSqlExpressions(h)`, but `enableSqlExpressions` currently always returns `false`, causing SQL expressions to fail with `fmt.Errorf("sqlExpressions is not implemented")` unconditionally. As a result, SQL expression functionality cannot be restored by flipping a flag; it would require code changes/revert and redeploy.

adjudication_records.issue_text: pkg/expr/reader.go:213 — Missing edge-case tests for both flag states (enabled/disabled) of `FlagSqlExpressions`, which would have immediately surfaced that `enableSqlExpressions` cannot return true under any input

adjudication.rationale:
The diff introduces `enableSqlExpressions` in `pkg/expr/reader.go`, but its implementation can never return `true`:
```go
enabled := !h.features.IsEnabledGlobally(featuremgmt.FlagSqlExpressions)
if enabled { return false }
return false
```
So `ReadQuery` will always error for `QueryTypeSQL` ("sqlExpressions is not implemented"), regardless of the flag state. The finding’s note about tests is ancillary, but the underlying claim (it cannot return true under any input) is directly verifiable and represents broken behavior introduced by this diff.
